note: One entry per page. mechanism: 'setting' = text of a journal setting (built into OJS 3.5.0-6), 'custom-page' = a custom navigation-menu page served at /<path>. 'checked' records what was verified against the pinned OJS source and the running sandbox (2026-11-10) before choosing the mechanism: built-ins are used wherever they exist. The static-pages plugin is not used: its template prints the title as an h2 with no h1 and is not themeable.
